searches.query: latest research papers AI ML simplified
searches.answer: The latest research papers in AI and ML include the Idefics2 model from April 2024, which improves OCR capabilities with a simplified architecture, and Phi 3 Vision from May 2024, the first multimodal model in the Phi family that reasons over images and text from images. Other notable papers include SimCLR from February 2020, a simplified framework for contrastive learning, and the Granite Code Models and Codestral 22B from May 2024, both designed for code generation tasks. Additionally, Morgan Stanley's research includes a provably convergent Schrödinger Bridge model for time series imputation and a policy evaluation method for rare events. Nature's AI Bytes column aims to simplify AI concepts for the life sciences community, and a document classification benchmark dataset on cybersecurity policy domain was also featured.
